purpose: One bounded same-suite metadata-category search after prior Jac/MSE and Jac/local_long negative confirmations; all prior null results remain disclosed. Metadata classes do not assert measured difficulty or preference.

previous_evidence.local_search_result: not_reproduced: Object Jac48 vs local_long49/50; Long local_long37 vs Jac35/50

fixed_science.target: same local converted Pi0 LIBERO base
fixed_science.noise: same per suite/task/init/request Gaussian seed protocol

selection.cost_aggregation: Median across completed gated services of same-input native policy Full / candidate Full-Fast-Fast cycle cost on the existing four-suite finite bank; excludes RPC/environment; does not cover every new task or prompt and proves no closed-loop speedup
selection.pairs: all unordered pairs of qualifying non-Full candidates; A/B names lexical order
selection.contrasts: Both ordered metadata-category assignments; A>B in categoryX and B>A in categoryY
tie_break_order: highest minimum of two category gaps
highest minimum of pair overall success
selection.no_eligible_pair: stop bounded search with no_candidate, report full matrix and prior negative results; no automatic further expansion

confirmation.primary_family: Exactly two discovery-selected opposite metadata-category directions; family-local alpha .05 only, no research-program-wide FWER claim
confirmation.primary_test: One-sided exact12task block signflip over integer five-init task differences; enumerate all4096 assignments including ties, Holm2
confirmation.sensitivity_test: one-sided paired-case exact McNemar, Holm2; repeated-initial-state independence not assumed for main inference
required_for_complementarity: both observed directional gaps strictly positive
both Holm2 task-block p-values strictly below0.05
both task-cluster95 lower bounds strictly positive
all leave-one-task-out directional gaps strictly positive
both candidates overall success>=0.75 and>=Full minus0.15
confirmation.timing: report native policy and full RPC per executed action, episode and preparation cost, and available contention observations; no guarantee of equivalence/noninferiority/exclusive-GPU timing
confirmation.if_not_reproduced: report not_reproduced; no automatic repeated search for significance

execution.technical_retry: only missing cases after inspected technical interruption; preserve earliest valid outcomes and prior failed attempt logs
execution.resource_controller: Separate borrowed-resource controller; source pinned with final runtime before manifest freeze

limitations: Classes describe BDDL metadata, not measured preference or difficulty; shared scenes and20 prompts among24 tasks may induce dependence.
Task sign-exchangeability is an inference assumption;12 task blocks per category limit precision.
No equivalence, noninferiority, runtime selection benefit, all-prompt gate coverage, or overall research-program FWER .05 claim.
No candidate or failed confirmation ends this792episode branch; all valid failures retained.

fixed_input_reference.scope: Finite old four-suite numerical reference; new24task first observations/prompt/noise are checked independently, without claiming all20prompts numerical coverage.
